newsitem.title: UK: SIX OF THE BEST GOLFERS LINE UP FOR ALFRED DUNHILL CUP.
newsitem.headline: SIX OF THE BEST GOLFERS LINE UP FOR ALFRED DUNHILL CUP.

text.p: Six of the world's top 12 players will be taking part in the one-million-pound ($1.55 million) Alfred Dunhill Cup world team golf event at St Andrews from October 10 to 13.
Greg Norman plays for Australia, Ernie Els for South Africa, Colin Montgomerie for defending champions Scotland, Phil Mickelson and Mark O'Meara for the United States and Nick Price for Zimbabwe.
Norman will play alongside 1995 PGA champion Steve Elkington and Craig Parry, while Els's teammates will be David Frost and Retief Goosen.
The third American will be fast rising Steve Stricker while Price's teammates for Zimbabwe will, as usual, be Mark McNulty and Tony Johnstone.
Scotland show one change from the team that took the trophy for the first time last season, Raymond Russell qualifying ahead of Sam Torrance in the team with Montgomerie and Andrew Coltart.
England and Wales will be without their top players after Nick Faldo and Ian Woosnam turned down the chance to represent their respective countries.
England's team will comprise Barry Lane, Jon Lomas and Lee Westwood while the Welsh team will be Paul Affleck, Mark Mouland and Phillip Price.
The format remains the same, with the 16 teams being drawn into four round robin groups and the winners of each going through to semifinals.
